extract_metadata: false omits the YAML frontmatter block from markdown output

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"content\":{\"extract_metadata\":false}}")
let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.scrape(engine: engineObj, url: url)
debugPrint(result.statusCode())
debugPrint(result.metadata().title() as Any)
debugPrint(result.markdown()?.content() as Any)
```
